selection_reason: Distinct source groups and visually stable question evidence; soccer association failures excluded from first codec smoke test.
roi_policy: Static bounding union of sampled API boxes, applied to every frame; offline noncausal VOD baseline, not tracking.
rate_control: Two-pass ABR, adjusted to actual complete MP4 bytes; AQ mode 1 and mbtree off in both treatments.
qa_protocol: One blind six-frame question-answering call per encoded candidate and per original reference; no ROI boxes or answers provided.
budget_selection_note: Case-dependent feasibility ladder: 720p text 32/64/128 KiB, 1080p cooking 64/128/256 KiB, detailed 1080p street 128/256/512 KiB. Chosen before QA, not to maximize measured QA gains. Previous 32 KiB cooking target rejected by x264 minimum bitrate.
